invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.089且RSI跌破40，或融资费率Z-score回落至50%以下（过热缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.089 with RSI falling below 40, or funding rate Z-score drops below 50% (overheating eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$67000且融资费率Z-score回升至-50%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势恶化（跌破关键支撑）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $67000 with funding Z-score rising above -50% (short pressure eases), or daily trend worsens (breaking key support).
